notes: The directive he is unrepresented because the preposition לַ already holds the *at* that would carry the direction (rule 32); the italic *gate* completes מִזְרָח under rule 31.
The prepositional phrase is the clause's predicate here, so עַל carries the supplied copula (rule 49), unlike the nominal predicates of 31:12.
קָדְשֵׁי הַקֳּדָשִׁים is split rather than fused, each side holding English of its own (rule 2); the indivisible reading is named in the unit note.
